visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoor street scene in a busy commercial district. A woman wearing a black and white patterned coat walks while holding the long handles of a cream-colored tote bag used as a walking harness for a toddler in pink clothing. A young boy in a blue and green hoodie walks alongside them. (2) The woman holds up a light blue dress with a gold bow in front of the toddler. The background features bright urban signage, including the iconic Glico Man landmark. (3) Transition to an indoor kitchen. A woman with dark hair and a black shirt stands at a white marble counter holding a plain tote bag and scissors, demonstrating materials for a DIY project. (4) Close-up shot of the woman's hands using scissors to cut the bottom of the canvas tote bag on the table, following red arrow guides. (5) The woman holds up the modified tote bag, now cut into a harness shape, and smiles at the camera. (6) A montage of the woman using a white sewing machine to stitch together the blue lace fabric of an old dress. (7) Close-up of the sewing process where the blue dress skirt is being attached to the canvas harness. (8) Back to the outdoor street scene. The toddler is now walking comfortably in the finished blue dress harness, which appears like a stylish outfit while being functional. (9) Indoor shot of the toddler standing in just the white harness base, laughing and balancing as the mother holds the handles. (10) The toddler sits indoors while a large golden retriever wags its tail, gently brushing against her face, causing her to giggle.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 adult female creator, 1 young boy, 1 female toddler, and approximately 20-25 passersby in the background of outdoor shots.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An adult female with long dark hair wearing a black shirt indoors and a black-and-white coat outdoors; a toddler girl in a pink outfit and later a blue dress; a young boy in a blue/green hoodie and a green hat.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Outdoor: Dotonbori, Osaka, featuring the Glico Man billboard and various neon signs. Indoor: A modern apartment with white marble counters, light wood flooring, and artistic decor.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male narration starts over a cheerful acoustic guitar BGM with a steady drum beat. Ambient outdoor murmurs are audible at a low level. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of promotional text on screen. (3) The acoustic texture shifts to a cleaner indoor room tone as the narration continues to describe the project materials. (4) A short metallic 'snip' SFX is heard as the scissors cut the canvas bag. (5) Mechanical whirring and vibrating sounds from a sewing machine are layered over the BGM during the assembly phase. (6) Outdoor city ambiance returns with muffled voices in the background while the narrator summarizes the finished product's benefits. (7) High-pitched giggling and laughter from a child dominate the final five seconds, accompanied by rhythmic percussive thumping sounds (dog tail) and soft animal panting.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Evidence -> Step 1 -> Step 2 -> Step 3 -> Result -> Extra Clip.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a creative and cost-effective DIY method for parents to transform an old tote bag and an outgrown dress into a functional and fashionable toddler walking harness.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-arousal narration style and fast-paced editing typical of social media life-hacks. The inclusion of a famous landmark (Glico Man) and a final humorous clip with a pet dog enhances engagement and shareability.
